tools.name: search_hotels
tools.description: Search hotels in a city or region with live prices and availability. Filters: price range, star rating, property type, free cancellation, breakfast, and amenities (pool, parking, spa, wifi, fitness, beach, kitchen, jacuzzi, balcony, business, kids, skiing, pet-friendly, ev-charger). For several room

tools.name: search_hotels_by_geo
tools.description: Search hotels around a named place (`place`, e.g. "Shibuya Station", "Times Square") or a coordinate (`lat`/`lng`), within a radius in metres (max 70,000). `country_code` narrows an ambiguous place name. Dates default to tomorrow for three nights. Returns hotels with live prices and distance.

tools.name: get_nearby_hotels
tools.description: List hotels near a named place or coordinate, with dates defaulting to tomorrow for three nights. Returns hotels with live prices and distance.

tools.name: get_hotel_details
tools.description: Full details for one hotel by id or slug: description, amenities, check-in and check-out times, policies, star rating, review summary, room types, photos and address.

tools.name: get_live_rates
tools.description: Live room rates and availability for one hotel and date range: price, room type, meal plan, cancellation policy and payment terms for each rate. For several rooms, `rooms` takes one entry per room, and each rate then covers the whole party.

tools.name: get_nearby_places
tools.description: Attractions, restaurants, airports and landmarks near a hotel, nearest first, with straight-line distance in km. `place_type` filters by kind.

tools.name: compare_hotels
tools.description: Compare 2 to 5 hotels side by side for given dates: live price, stars, rating, amenities, free cancellation, breakfast, check-in and check-out times, and key differences.

tools.name: book_on_myservice
tools.description: Create a link to book a hotel on myservice.pk. The link opens MyService AI with the hotel, dates and party filled in; the user signs in, confirms the live price, enters guest details and pays there. This tool books, holds and charges nothing. tools.description: Popular destination cities with hotel counts, images and highlights.

tools.name: get_featured_hotels
tools.description: A curated selection of well-rated hotels across destinations.
